commitment.family_split_basis: Named conceptual family absent from dev; operators, curator and model family are shared, so no broad distribution-independence claim.
commitment.sealing: SHA-256 of ZIP including a private 256-bit nonce; integrity commitment, not encryption.
commitment.authoring_boundary: After preliminary dev inspection; before final multi-baseline evaluation. No holdout evaluation or solver run.
commitment.revision_reason: Design correction: preserve v1 but replace future-evaluation candidate with a conceptual family absent from dev. Not a post-hoc confirmatory result.
commitment.limitation: One conceptual family, same curator, no independent human validation; unused prospective material only, not qualified confirmatory evidence.

metric_definitions.wrong_refuted: REFUTED while the frozen formal C is true over its entire bounded quantifier domain. Excludes inconsistent/undefined claims.
metric_definitions.unsupported_refuted: REFUTED without valid in-domain submitted witness, forall semantics and C=>O authority. The underlying C might still be false elsewhere.
metric_definitions.true_counterexample_recall: Authorized REFUTED decisions divided by cases whose candidate-specific gold decision is REFUTED.
metric_definitions.relation_accuracy: Predicted pointwise relation divided by all cases, including ambiguous/out-of-scope/unknown labels. LLM candidate gold is recomputed with an independent evaluator against frozen C membership.
metric_definitions.unknown_precision_recall: UNKNOWN measured against candidate-specific gold inability to lift the submitted evidence. It does not validate unknown handling on arbitrary natural language.
metric_definitions.cost: Zero additional provider calls for deterministic evaluation. LLM token/time/price receipts are null if not observable; no fabricated zero.

limits: Synthetic tiny finite domains; development set was used for implementation verification.
Gold has separate role/file/procedure provenance, but no external human annotation or model-family independence.
All claims concern supplied formal anchors; original natural-language semantic fidelity remains unproven.
No claim of superiority over PBT-Bench, Anthropic PBT, SMT systems, CrossHair, or a fresh independently sampled LLM.
Finite DSL is data-only; separate Python environment is process/dependency isolation, not an OS security sandbox.
Holdout v2 names a conceptual family absent from dev, but was authored after preliminary dev inspection by the same curator and remains unused; not qualified confirmatory evidence.
